title: Unreadable-folders view: one path-sorted row per failed folder, with its kind and a readable reason
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: C1 (derived from Done-when #1): every entry in the failed-folder record gives exactly one row with its full path, and no row comes from anywhere else; unit test over partly-read, not-opened and repeated entries, compared one to one: partial
C2 (derived from Done-when #2): rows are flat and sorted by path, with no cap, no 'N more not shown' line and no grouping; test with 10,050 entries (U-104): partial
C3 (derived from Done-when #3): each row is marked 'could not be opened' or 'only partly read', taken from the engine's record; test against both kinds (U-103): missing

C4 (derived from Done-when #4): the common codes get short plain phrases (access denied; in use by another program for sharing/lock violations; network or share error for the network family including 59 and 64); table test per code: missing
C5 (derived from Done-when #5): every other code shows Windows' own message in the user's display language together with the code number; test with 362, 363 and the reparse codes: partial
C6 (derived from Done-when #6): no reason is ever empty; a code with no system message shows a fallback that names the code; test with such a code: partial

C7 (derived from Done-when #7): the view only reads the scan's result and never touches the filesystem; rule in fitness.yaml, xUnit twin in ArchitectureRulesTests, plant row in the rules harness: missing

Placement: the view logic goes in an App file linked into Core.Tests (repo convention, chosen here) rather than a Core folder such as src/FsAnalyser.Core/NoFs/, where the rule spike's scratch copy put it.
What 'sorted by path' means: tree order with the separator lowest (chosen) or plain OrdinalIgnoreCase / culture order. The Done-when does not say.
Code 65 (ERROR_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED) goes under 'access denied' (chosen) rather than 'network or share error'.
Row presentation: one text line '{Path} — {kind}: {reason}' (chosen) rather than separate columns for path, kind and reason.
Wording across surfaces: the folder tree says 'could not be read in full' where this list says 'only partly read' (fixed by Done-when #3). Aligning the tree is left to a later slice.
Header N counts distinct rows (chosen) rather than raw record entries.

Rule 2 still catches only the ternary shape. A switch expression or an if/else that picks an UnreadableKind in App code passes it, and the Fact's comment says so. This carries over from attempt 1; m1 remains deferred by decision.
deviation: F30 pins `lines: {xunit: 1, fitness: 1}`. That was not in the fix as written, but it is what makes the row prove the twin fires on the `?` line itself, not merely somewhere in the plant.
